_comment: HTTP 401 from any authenticated endpoint. TrainingPeaks' documented meaning is 'bad, expired or missing authorization header'. The exact JSON envelope is not guaranteed and may be empty; the STATUS CODE is authoritative. Resolution: refresh the access token and retry.
_notes: Access tokens live about 1 hour (expires_in documented at 600s, observed up to 3600s). Refresh proactively before expiry; clock skew or server-side revocation can still yield a 401 on a token that looks valid locally, so a force-refresh-and-retry-once path is recommended.
